card.name: Linking words in drug interaction statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words (when, with, using, in, on) or the word patients in drug interaction and dosing-population sentences, right after a verb like evaluated, conducted, or coadministration.

modes.label: Study-method links
modes.description: Words like when or using after 'evaluated' or 'conducted' in interaction study statements.
modes.example: The effect of paroxetine on the pharmacokinetics of atomoxetine has been evaluated<< when>> both drugs were at steady state.

modes.label: Coadministration links
modes.description: The word with after coadministration or combinations.
modes.example: Coadministration<< with>> oral doses of a P-gp and

modes.label: Patient group links
modes.description: The word patients or on after 'in' or 'in patients' when naming a patient group, such as those with hepatic impairment or on a co-medication.
modes.example: LITFULO is not recommended in<< patients>> with severe (Child Pugh C)

card.writes: Weakly promotes 'peak' and 'transfer' words, with no clear overall effect.
card.plain: It marks small connecting words in sentences about how drugs were studied together or which patients a dose applies to.
